body:
### 中文更新日志
* **官方直连技术支持系统**：
  * 新增应用内「Easy-Unraid 官方支持」双向实时沟通窗口，面向全体用户（标准版与 Pro 高级版）开放；
  * 自动关联脱敏设备识别码、客户端版本与 Unraid 系统版本，无需手动翻找环境参数；
  * 支持发送截图、日志文件附件（最大 20MB），并在设置中心「关于」、「高级版激活」与「换绑优盘」页面提供快捷直达入口。
* **一键脱敏附带运行诊断日志**：
  * 客服窗口顶部与「运行诊断日志」控制台新增「一键附带诊断日志」功能；
  * 自动对密码、API Key、SSH 私钥、Token 等敏感凭据执行正则脱敏过滤后打包上传，大幅提升远程排障效率。

### English Changelog
* **Official Direct Technical Support System**:
  * Added an in-app real-time two-way "Easy-Unraid Support" dialog available to both Free and Pro users;
  * Automatically attaches masked Device ID, client app version, and Unraid OS version for faster troubleshooting;
  * Supports uploading screenshots and log attachments (up to 20MB) with quick entry points in Settings (About, Pro License, and Flash Rebind).
* **One-Click Sanitized Diagnostic Log Attachment**:
  * Added a "One-Click Attach Diagnostic Log" action in both the Support dialog and the Diagnostic Log console;
  * Automatically masks sensitive credentials (passwords, API keys, SSH keys, tokens) before packaging and uploading logs.
